input.code:
var py = `
import itertools, json

prices = {
 "Balloons":40,"Candy Bar":24,"Chocolate Box":32,"Coasters":20,"Decorative Lights":47,
 "Fine Wine":60,"Gourmet Cheese":65,"Keychain":25,"Noise Maker":31,"Notepad":24,
 "Party Hat":31,"Pen":24,"Premium Champagne":126,"Sparkling Cider":30,"Sticker":25}
names = list(prices.keys())
n = len(names)

# valid size tuples: n1:n2 in [1:3,1:2] -> 2*n1<=n2<=3*n1 ; same n2:n3 ; n3:n4 in [1:2,1:1] -> n3<=n4<=2*n3
sizes = []
for n1 in range(1, n):
    for n2 in range(2*n1, 3*n1+1):
        for n3 in range(2*n2, 3*n2+1):
            for n4 in range(n3, 2*n3+1):
                if n1+n2+n3+n4 <= n:
                    sizes.append((n1,n2,n3,n4))
print("size options:", sizes)

best = []
idxs = list(range(n))
pv = [prices[k] for k in names]

for (n1,n2,n3,n4) in sizes:
    for S1 in itertools.combinations(idxs, n1):
        v1 = sum(pv[i] for i in S1)
        r1 = [i for i in idxs if i not in S1]
        for S2 in itertools.combinations(r1, n2):
            v2 = sum(pv[i] for i in S2)
            if abs(v1-v2) > 20: continue
            if v1+v2 > 500: continue
            r2 = [i for i in r1 if i not in S2]
            lo2, hi2 = min(v1,v2), max(v1,v2)
            for S3 in itertools.combinations(r2, n3):
                v3 = sum(pv[i] for i in S3)
                lo3, hi3 = min(lo2,v3), max(hi2,v3)
                if hi3-lo3 > 20: continue
                if v1+v2+v3 > 500: continue
                r3 = [i for i in r2 if i not in S3]
                for S4 in itertools.combinations(r3, n4):
                    v4 = sum(pv[i] for i in S4)
                    lo, hi = min(lo3,v4), max(hi3,v4)
                    if hi-lo > 20: continue
                    tot = v1+v2+v3+v4
                    if tot > 500: continue
                    best.append((tot, -(hi-lo), (n1,n2,n3,n4), S1,S2,S3,S4, (v1,v2,v3,v4)))

best.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1]), reverse=True)
print("solutions found:", len(best))
for b in best[:10]:
    tot, negspread, sz, S1,S2,S3,S4, vs = b
    print("total=",tot,"spread=",-negspread,"sizes=",sz,"values=",vs)
    print("   1st:", [names[i] for i in S1])
    print("   2nd:", [names[i] for i in S2])
    print("   3rd:", [names[i] for i in S3])
    print("   part:", [names[i] for i in S4])
`;
await machine.writeToFile({ text: py, path: "/tmp/solve.py", overwrite: true })
var out = await machine.exec({ command: "cd /tmp && timeout 600 python3 solve.py", timeout: 600 })
console.log(out.stdout.slice(0, 4000))
console.log("ERR", out.stderr.slice(0,1000))
